svg.title: Speed-up with 8 requests at once, by model

M2 Max · 96 GB: Qwen3.5-4B 2.66x (152 to 403 tokens/s), Qwen3.5-9B 3.03x (72 to 220 tokens/s), Qwen3.8-27B 3.13x (25 to 78 tokens/s). M5 Pro · 24 GB: Qwen3.5-4B 1.48x (258 to 382 tokens/s), Qwen3.5-9B 1.58x (145 to 229 tokens/s).
